chunks: Mūsā ibn Bakr narrated from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A girl is not to be consummated with until nine years, or ten, come for her.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.بِالْجَارِيَةِ: with the young girl or female minor

ai.seo_question: At what age does this hadith say a girl may be consummated in marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning the timing of marital consummation with a young girl. It places a minimum age threshold, indicating that consummation should not occur until she has reached nine or ten years of age.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5521 - Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said: "
A girl should not be consummated in marriage until she reaches nine or ten years of age."
